answer: Each epoch runs a Falcon admission auction with 20 entry slots, so a hollow identity with no history or stake cannot enter for free. Bids are sealed with a cipher; winners lock a deposit of twice their 30-day expected earnings for 20 epochs, and honest agents earn it back while cheaters lose it. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 bids at 40 credits each, 40,000 credits, while one honest agent pays 40 credits once and keeps its full share.
